patterns: APPSC asks type-identification one-liners: volcanic mountain = Etna; young fold among Appalachians/Aravallis/Alps/Urals = Alps; horst = block mountain.
APPSC Group-1 used an 'incorrect statement' item: orogeny is NOT continent building (that is epeirogeny).
Other PSCs repeat: Aravalli oldest range, Guru Shikhar in Rajasthan, Narmada/Death Valley = rift valley, Sierra Nevada = block not young fold, epeirogenic = vertical movements.
UPSC 2024 'how many rows matched' (Vosges/Alps wrong) and evidence for Himalaya being young.
App covers isostasy (Airy/Pratt) and Kober in more depth than PYQs show; also carries some off-topic landform items (dunes, karst, estuary).
